facts.summary: Ration quota refers to the quantity of eligible food commodities that a beneficiary or household is entitled to receive under the applicable PDS rules.
purpose: Understand the quantity of ration available to an eligible beneficiary.
Understand how the applicable quota determines ration allocation.
Check questions related to monthly ration entitlement.
facts.quota_basis: The applicable ration quota depends on the beneficiary category, household details, commodity and rules implemented by the concerned State or Union Territory.
facts.monthly_quota: The applicable entitlement may be defined on a monthly basis according to the beneficiary category and PDS rules.
commodities: Other food commodities applicable under the relevant PDS entitlement.
facts.state_specific: Ration entitlement rules and quantities can vary according to the applicable State/UT implementation and beneficiary category.
facts.eligibility: Only beneficiaries who meet the applicable eligibility conditions receive the corresponding PDS entitlement.
facts.quota_difference: Ration quota refers to the entitled quantity, while ration price refers to the applicable price of the commodity.
facts.verification: Beneficiaries should use their official ration-card or PDS records to verify their applicable entitlement.
important_notes: Do not assume one fixed quota applies to every beneficiary.
Do not confuse ration quota with ration not received.
A question about missing ration should use the ration_not_received intent.
A question about the price of ration should use the ration_price intent.
A question about which commodities are provided should use the ration_items_list intent.

faqs.question: What is ration quota?
faqs.answer: Ration quota is the quantity of eligible food commodities that a beneficiary or household is entitled to receive under the applicable PDS rules.

faqs.question: How much ration can I get?
faqs.answer: The applicable quantity depends on your beneficiary category, household details, commodity and the PDS rules implemented by the concerned State or Union Territory.

faqs.question: Is ration quota the same for everyone?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Ration entitlement can vary according to beneficiary category and the applicable State/UT rules.

faqs.question: Is ration quota monthly?
faqs.answer: The applicable entitlement may be defined on a monthly basis under the relevant PDS rules.

faqs.question: Does ration quota include rice and wheat?
faqs.answer: Rice and wheat may be included where they form part of the applicable PDS entitlement for the beneficiary.

faqs.question: Where can I check my ration quota?
faqs.answer: Use your official ration-card or PDS records to verify the entitlement applicable to your beneficiary category.

faqs.question: I did not receive my ration. Is that a quota issue?
faqs.answer: If you were entitled to ration but did not receive it, the issue is more appropriately handled as a ration-not-received problem rather than a general quota inquiry.
